text:
oncall-bot: Pager: api-inference (prod, us-west-2) - spike in 5xx and increased p95 latency. Bridge: https://bridge.example/xyz. Assigned: Sam (P1).
Sam: ack. joining bridge now. grabbing logs, any customer-facing impact known?
Mira: looking... seeing a KV cache thrash pattern, lots of evictions around 03:12 UTC. memory pressure on pool-A nodes.```
[2026-03-15T03:12Z] eviction_count=1324, avg_latency_ms=420
``` 
Lee: adding that autoscaler was busy scaling up but pods hit max and started to queue.
Karen: FYI support: several customers reported 500s intermittently, ~15% of requests in the window. Raising customer-impact. I'll start comms doc.
Sam: OK plan: 1) divert traffic to fallback model-quantized-v1 (lower memory) 2) increase pool size temporarily 3) tune alert thresholds to avoid repeat noise. Anyone object?
Mira: no objections, triggering routing change now.
DevopsRunner: reroute executed: traffic % to model-quantized-v1 = 60 -> 0. Command: `curl -X POST https://api-redwood/route -d '{ "from":"model-A","to":"model-quantized-v1","pct":60 }'`
Sam: taking bridge. oncall handoff to Lee in 30m if stable.
Lee: on it. I've also opened infra ticket: INFRA-4821
Karen: comms draft here: https://docs.company/incident/INFRA-4821-comms — please review. :loudspeaker:
Mira: after reroute p95 dropped from 420ms -> 180ms, 5xx rate dropped to 1.2%. still monitoring.
Sam: good. declare mitigation in place. we'll keep paging suppressed for lower-level alerts and only page on SLO breach. Can we adjust alert rule now?
DevopsRunner: proposed alert change (will apply via ruleset):
```
ALERT ApiHighErrorRate
IF sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"api\",code=~\"5..\"}[5m])) by (service) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (service) > 0.05
FOR 5m
LABELS { severity=\"page\" }
```
Change: only page when service-wide 5xx ratio > 5% for 5m (was 1% before).
Mira: +1, reduces noise. also add dedupe window to route similar alerts to a single page.
Karen: timeline: start postmortem on Mon, 10:00am PT. Owner: Sam. Drafting action items now.
Sam: action items I'm capturing:
- INFRA-4821: increase pool max and revisit autoscaler config (Lee) 
- INFRA-4822: KV cache metrics and eviction alert (Mira)
- INFRA-4823: Routing fallback runbook update + test (Sam)
- INFRA-4824: Alert rule change + dedupe window (DevopsRunner)
- INFRA-4825: Customer comms & follow-ups (Karen)
Please add Jira links when created.
Lee: assigned INFRA-4821 to myself, ETA Wed EOD.
Mira: INFRA-4822 created, ETA Tue.
DevopsRunner: INFRA-4824 created and PR opened: https://git.company/rules/123
Karen: comms posted, flagged customers who've seen errors. filed support follow-ups.
Sam: pairing with Mira to collect small prompt test set to run against model-quantized-v1 to guard quality regressions before long-term routing. plan smoke tests daily.
Mira: note for postmortem: look at KV cache TTL tuning and memory footprint per model shard. suspect kernel param + scheduler interactions.
DevopsRunner: also recommend adding an alert on average eviction_rate > 100/min to preempt cascade.
Sam: agreed. We'll also update SLO docs: current p95 target for inference end-to-end is 250ms; team to review if fallback should change SLOs or be behind different SLOs.
Karen: scheduled follow-up sync with sales/eng on Mon 11:00am PT to review customer impact and remediation timeline.
oncall-bot: Incident status changed to mitigated by Sam. Bridge closed at 04:15 UTC. Postmortem scheduled by Sam for 2026-03-16 17:00 UTC. Reminder will be posted 24h before.
Sam: thanks everyone. leaving notes for handoff to rotation. Lee, you're primary for next 12h.
Lee: ack, monitoring dashboards up. Will escalate if metric trends back up.
Karen: adding postmortem template link: https://pm.company/postmortem-template — use bullet list for action owners and completion dates.
Sam: closing thread for now. will update postmortem doc with timeline and evidence. :white_check_mark:
